title: Min Stack
description: Design a stack that supports push, pop, top, and retrieving the minimum element, all in constant time.

reference.use_case: Supporting nested push/undo operations while instantly answering which value is currently the minimum, such as the most restrictive setting in effect across nested scopes.
system_examples: Nested transaction savepoints and scoped configuration — reporting the tightest active limit after each rollback
Stream processors — two such stacks form a queue with O(1) min/max for sliding-window aggregates
reference.explanation: Store with each pushed value the minimum at that depth, so getMin is O(1) and stays correct after pops. Its main real use is as a building block: two min-stacks make a queue with amortized O(1) min/max, used for sliding-window aggregation.
